question: Which element does each field of the Insurance Portal's contract-create form host, what identity does the field tree report for it, and what control does its record expect?

capture.writes: one: the armed test re-derives this record from the files below and writes it only when a value moved, and it refuses to write a candidate that is not a fixed point of this suite’s default pin
capture.note: the instant this record was first written; every re-capture derives through it, so the record moves no byte for a clock - the instant the page was read is page.capturedAt, which comes from the reading it derives from

sources.contributes: the portal page reading: the route it drove, the form it found, the field-tree identities and the element each field hosts, as M066 captured them
the field-state reading whose `fields` keys are the identity shape this record carries, recorded from the fixture’s /field-form page

identity.expression: angularAiFieldState.read({ fields, root, submitState }).fields, then its own keys
identity.meaning: a field’s identity is the key the read copies from state.fields: the module echoes every key verbatim and invents none, so an identity this record carries is the key it is keyed by and a second spelling of one field is the defect this record refuses

fallback.why: the portal carries a form whose fields host elements: 3 of the 4 fields research/raw/m066-schema-record.json read on /contract/create host one (policyNumber <input>, insuranceStartOn <p-datepicker>, customer <p-select>), so the fixture route /field-form was not needed and was not driven

expected.reason: the control the policyNumber field's record expects was not read: the one page reading this record derives from (research/raw/m066-schema-record.json) carries the 10 keys ["boundFields","disabled","disabledType","element","field","fieldDisabled","formText","hidden","id","nameAttr"] for a field and none of them names a control a field expects; this task read no page of its own, and package.json declares 30 packages of which 0 is @angular/material or @angular/cdk, so no control library in this tree names one either - recorded as an absence, never inferred from the field's label
